title: fix(app-shell): Studio's cross-package metadata list keeps its URL and lists every package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGL1oMxnpMEbXR6kM6npjVg)_

Fixes #29566

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6586144352).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio「全部元数据」的跨包列表（`/studio/~all/metadata/TYPE`）不再自己往地址里补 `?package=`，也不再被带去某一个包的页面；它列出读到的所有行（各个包的条目，加上不属于任何包的条目），每行点开时进入它所属的包。只有「新建」时才挑一个包（沿用 Setup 列表原来的挑法），并打开那个包的新建页。
- 为什么改：列表在区域没有指定包时，会把第一个项目包写进 `?package=`，区域随即把页面转到那个包。于是跨包列表根本打不开，带 `?package=all` 也一样。所有不带包的 Setup 元数据旧链接和「已打包自动化」书签都落在这里（验收项 platform-core.setup-metadata-redirects-to-studio 的 acceptance[0] 和 [3]）。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `ResourceListPage.tsx` 里跨包分支的范围判断（宿主存在、packageId 为空、不在环境范围）。某个包的区域和 Setup 自己的列表行为不变，有对照用例钉住。跨包列表现在会显示平台包和无包条目，这是该分支的既定含义。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx`（`allLeg`、`pickedPackage` / `activePackage` 的拆分、修补 effect 里的 `if (host) return`、`handleCreate` 的跨包分支）；新测试 `StudioMetadataArea.allList-29566.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioMetadataArea.allList-29566.test.tsx`，预期 6 个用例全过；把 `ResourceListPage.tsx` 换回 main 的版本时其中 4 个转红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ResourceListPage.tsx`** (`DefaultMetadataList`): a new `allLeg` flag is true under the area's cross-package leg outside the environment scope (host present, `packageId` null, no `?scope=environment`). On that leg:
  - the `?package=` repair effect never runs (it now returns for any host, since a package's area was already exempt);
  - the list is scoped to no package: `activePackage` is `null`, and `scopedItems` keeps every row the read returns, as the environment scope already does. Each row still links with its owning package's `?package=`, so opening a row moves onto that package's leg (`areaLocationRedirect`); a package-less row opens by name on the cross-package leg;
  - the "No project packages installed" empty state and the packages-pending wait do not apply, because the leg needs no project package to list;
  - Create picks a package through the existing pick, now named `pickedPackage` (the current app's package, then the project package owning the most rows of the type, then the first project package), and navigates to `./new?package=PICK`, which the area opens as that package's create. With no project package it opens the existing create-a-package dialog.
- A package's area (host with a `packageId`) and Setup's list (no host) take the same branches as before; `pickedPackage` is the old `activePackage` memo minus its host line.
- **Comment-only:** `metadata-admin/metadataAreaHost.ts` (the `packageId` doc and the scope bullet) and `studio-design/metadataArea.ts` (the `~all` leg doc and `areaLocationRedirect`'s no-`?package=` bullet) now say that the cross-package leg lists a type across packages and repairs no package in.

## Tests

- **New `studio-design/StudioMetadataArea.allList-29566.test.tsx`**, through the area's real routes (`/studio/~all/metadata/*`, `/studio/:packageId/metadata/*`) with the real list page. Only the metadata client, the types list, the locale, the author gate and the writable probe are doubled:
  - `/studio/~all/metadata/object` and `/studio/~all/metadata/object?package=all` keep their URL and list rows of two project packages, a platform package and a package-less row; each row's href names its owning package;
  - `/studio/~all/metadata/flow` (the Packaged automation landing) keeps its URL and lists both packages' flows;
  - Create on the cross-package list lands on `/studio/com.example.crm/metadata/object/new?package=com.example.crm`;
  - controls: a package's area keeps its leg and lists only its own rows; Setup's list (no area) still repairs `?package=` onto a project package.
- **Red on main:** with `ResourceListPage.tsx` restored to the main blob (`fce5d4d2`, `allLeg` count 0 on disk), 4 of 6 go red: both `~all/object` cases, the `~all/flow` case and the create case. Both controls stay green. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob hash equals HEAD's.
- 35 test files that name `ResourceListPage`, `MetadataResourceListPage`, `metadataAreaHost`, `metadataArea` or `StudioMetadataArea`: 478/478 passed.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65/65 tasks, exit 0. ESLint on the four changed files: 0 errors; the 23 warnings in `ResourceListPage.tsx` are the same 23 the main blob has.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **What the cross-package list shows.** Every row the read returns, including platform packages' items and rows of no package, as the leg is defined (`metadataArea.ts`: every package plus the environment's own items). The seat accepted this reading in the claim; a project-packages-only list would be a follow-up.
- **The claim names `studio-design/metadataAreaHost.ts`;** the file is `metadata-admin/metadataAreaHost.ts`. It is the one `metadataAreaHost.ts` in the tree, and the edit there is comment-only, as claimed.
- Not re-measured on a live console; the routing is pinned in jsdom through the real area and list.
